purpose: Immutable release-candidate snapshot correcting rc1's RC1-QA-001 finding: N00/N20/N30's fresh prompts now reference this package's actually enforced graph (implementation.graph.v4.yaml), and the automated suite gained a real, mutation-proven regression test proving it.

supersedes_failed_session.note: Preserved byte-for-byte unchanged and not reopened, edited, or overridden. Its one finding, RC1-QA-001 ("Automated suite does not prove fresh-prompt consistency"), was real and specific: N00/N20/N30 referenced a nonexistent implementation.graph.v1.yaml instead of this package's actually enforced implementation.graph.v4.yaml, and no test read or validated the prompts to catch it. This rc2 snapshot exists solely to fix that defect; rc1 itself, and its own supersession of the original 4-round session, are untouched.

source_note: Every file below is byte-identical to the live package-v2 file at the same relative path at snapshot time, reconfirmed immediately before this snapshot was taken: `python3 -m pytest -q plans/27_langgraph_curriculum_factory_remediation/execution_package_v2/tests/test_execution_package_v2.py` -> 97 passed; `python3 plans/27_langgraph_curriculum_factory_remediation/execution_package_v2/tools/validate_plan_v2.py` -> valid: true.
reviewed_artifact_note: The single file submitted to qa-gate-codex-run as --artifact. It embeds the full verbatim text of every file below whose logic is under review, so Codex's judged content is the reviewed logic itself, never a description of it and never a --ground source outside the hash chain.
deterministic_validation_note: controller/scan_node.py, tools/validate_plan_v2.py, and tests/test_execution_package_v2.py bind to their own absolute repo-relative path (e.g. tools/validate_plan_v2.py's hardcoded graph_flag, and every file's PACKAGE_DIR/REPO_ROOT arithmetic derived from Path(__file__).resolve()) as a deliberate PKGV2-QA-001/002 hardening, not an oversight -- unchanged since rc1. A byte-identical copy placed under release_candidate/rc2/ therefore cannot be independently re-executed in place -- confirmed directly, exactly as rc1 confirmed it: running this snapshot's own tools/validate_plan_v2.py raises 'No such file or directory .../release_candidate/schemas/...' because its REPO_ROOT arithmetic assumes the original nesting depth. Behavioral identity is therefore established by SHA-256 equality against the live plans/27_.../execution_package_v2/ files (below), which were reconfirmed passing immediately before this snapshot was taken (see source_note).
